user.title: Select paired remote
user.description: Pair your remote outside Home Assistant first, then wake it with an arrow button so it can be verified. Pick it from the list, or enter its Bluetooth address.

data_description.device: Remotes already paired on this Home Assistant host. Choose the manual option if yours is not listed.

manual.title: Enter paired remote address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of a remote that is already paired on this host.

data_description.address: Six pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by colons, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

configure.title: Select Assist pipeline
configure.description: Wake the remote with an arrow button before submitting. The integration starts in transcription-only mode; change this in the options once it works.

data_description.pipeline_id: The Assist pipeline that processes speech from this remote.

init.title: Voice settings
init.description: These settings control how presses are handled and how replies are spoken. Replacing a request cannot undo actions it already performed. Simultaneous full duplex is unavailable. Stopping after transcription does not disable tools built into a live speech provider; use a transcription-only provider when actions must be disabled.

data_description.pipeline_id: The Assist pipeline that processes speech: speech-to-text, conversation agent and text-to-speech. A removed pipeline fails with an error instead of falling back.
data_description.mode: Transcription only stops after speech recognition and plays no reply. Execute commands runs the whole pipeline and speaks the reply on the reply speaker.
data_description.speaker: The media player that speaks replies. Used only when executing commands. Choose no spoken reply to stop the pipeline before the reply is played.
data_description.output_mode: Automatic streaming starts speaking as soon as a streamed reply is ready. Waiting for the complete reply starts later but plays a finished audio file, which avoids breakup with providers that only produce speech at about real-time pace.
data_description.stream_head_start: Seconds to wait before playing a streamed reply, so the speaker has a lead to avoid breakup at the start. Replies that finish sooner play at once. Has no effect when waiting for the complete reply. 0 keeps the default behavior.
data_description.busy_processing: What to do when the button is pressed before the previous request is answered: reject the press, keep one pending request, or replace the current request. Replacing cannot undo actions already performed.
data_description.busy_playback: What to do when the button is pressed while a reply is playing: reject the press, answer one pending request afterward, or stop the reply and start the new request.
data_description.context_mode: Reuse keeps the Home Assistant conversation so follow-ups such as 'and double that?' work. Fresh makes every press an independent conversation.
data_description.input_mode: One request per hold records until the button is released. Alternating conversation keeps listening while the button is held: speak, pause, hear the reply, then speak again. It needs a hold-to-talk remote.
